blurb: A light pickup with a machine gun on the back: a driver, a gunner who fires all round and three passengers with their own weapons

notes.model: Recon Trike (Meshy Community, CC0; content/guns.json vehicles/recon_jeep.glb, 2026-11-10): a Warthog-style four-wheeler with a pintle machine gun on the roll cage over the cab and an open bed behind. Its tires are cut out as parts (wheel_*), so they spin, steer and ride the springs like the Car Kit truck's wheel meshes did. The Car Kit pickup it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/gun_jeep.glb).
notes.half: The box is unchanged (the re-skin keeps handling): the model is 4.4 m long and 2.44 m tall at the gun; its body is about 2.2 m wide and its tires stand out to 2.88 m.
notes.seats: Measured on the model (slices of its triangles): two cab seats with cushions 0.92 m up at z -0.05 (backrests at z -0.3, the floor 0.7 m up under the dash); the gun's ring on the cage roof at z 0.3, 2.3 m up, so the gunner stands behind its breech on the console between the cab and the bed (feet 1.05 m), shoulders out of the roof like a hatch gunner; the bed (floor 0.7 m) runs from z -1.2 to -2.0 between walls 1.1 m high at x ±0.9, where the two rail riders sit facing out. Roles, weapon and arcs unchanged.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height over the driver's cushion, under the cage roof (2.0 m).
notes.vehicle: Its own wheels (the model's tires, cut out as parts) on stiffer springs than the buggy's: a pickup. The suspension's contact points are unchanged.
